title: Aries × Virgo: now, and nearly ready.
old_caption: When one of you is already in the car and the other is still checking, a little notice goes a long way. Give a heads-up, let "good enough" be enough, and plan it together.

title: Libra × Capricorn: the romance and the agenda.
old_caption: Romance and routine can live on the same page. Add one small gesture for no reason, make the choice when it's yours to make, and put love on the calendar on purpose.

title: Cancer × Sagittarius: the nest and the map.
old_caption: Missing home on the road is a real feeling, and so is wanting to go. Call when you get there, try one trip together, and bring a little of home along.

title: Leo × Pisces: the speech and the tears.
old_caption: Big personalities and soft hearts can take care of each other. Ask how they feel, tell them they did well, and let a few happy tears be part of the evening.

title: Scorpio × Gemini: the deep end and the shallow end.
old_caption: Deep questions and light jokes both have a place. Answer one question honestly, let a joke just be a joke, and take turns choosing how deep the talk goes.

title: Aries × Pisces: the sprint and the daydream.
old_caption: Rushing to the finish can mean missing the best part. Slow your pace, say where you wandered off to, and notice the small moments together. Tag the friend who always stops for the lights.

title: Aries × Taurus: the spark and the slow burn.
old_caption: Fast and slow can share a table. Stay for dessert, say yes to one small surprise, and pack something warm so the slow one enjoys the adventure too.

title: Aquarius × Cancer: the theory and the feeling.
old_caption: Feelings don't need a theory, just a sentence. Say what you feel in plain words, trust that time apart isn't a goodbye, and remember the simplest answer is often a hug.

title: Gemini × Capricorn: the jokes and the goals.
old_caption: Goals feel lighter when there's room to laugh. Take an afternoon off, show up when you said you would, and put a little play right on the plan for next year.

title: Scorpio × Aquarius: the vault and the open door.
old_caption: Sharing good news is lovely; asking first is lovelier. Check before you tell the group, share one small secret when you're ready, and keep something just for the two of you.
